news.headline: Stocks at record highs, but Monday futures dip as oil climbs
news.why: The S&P closed at a record 7,758 Friday on rate-cut hopes; futures softened this morning as oil rose on fading hopes for a Strait of Hormuz reopening.

news.headline: Wednesday's July CPI is the week's main event
news.why: Headline inflation is seen ~3.4% YoY; a hot print would jolt the record-high market, a soft one cements September rate-cut bets. PPI follows Thursday.

news.headline: AI earnings in focus: CoreWeave and Applied Materials
news.why: A lighter but AI-heavy earnings week keeps the data-center trade front and center alongside the inflation data.

news.headline: DeepSeek's V4-Flash retrain now tops its own 'Pro' on agentic coding
news.why: A cheap 'flash' model beating the pricier tier on coding benchmarks — the clearest sign yet that open models are closing the gap for builders.

news.headline: The 'agentic' era: models that orchestrate multi-step workflows
news.why: August's releases lean hard into agents that can run complex tasks semi-autonomously — the capability behind tools like your build projects.

news.headline: Heads-up for builders: model retirements + an Aug 31 'price cliff'
news.why: Several hosted models are being retired later this month and pricing changes hit Aug 31 — worth checking if any of your projects call those endpoints.

news.headline: Israel rejects Trump's 15-point Gaza plan
news.why: Netanyahu says forces won't withdraw until Hamas fully disarms — a setback for the ceasefire framework that looked close last week.

news.headline: Iran sets steep conditions to reopen the Strait of Hormuz
news.why: Tehran wants sanctions lifted, forces withdrawn and war damages paid first — keeping a bid under oil prices and inflation risk.

news.headline: Zelenskyy: up to 50,000 North Korean troops headed to Russia
news.why: A major reported escalation in Pyongyang's support for Moscow's war effort.
